profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at SK hynix Memory Solutions, Inc
profile.summary:
Software Development:
   Firmware Verification Framework for SSD (C++/Node.js/Javascript)
   Kernel Development  
   Embedded SW: Packet Over Sonet (Sniffer Product)
   Inference Engine (AI using LISP)
   Machine Learning Class

ASIC Design:
    Low Power DSP Algorithm Implementation(Bluetooth MODEM, etc.)
    Experiences with Clock/Power Domain Analysis and DFT Issues
    Digital Layout using Cadence SoC-Encounter (Partition, Clock Tree, Static Timing Analysis)

FPGA Design and Test/Debug:
    Low Power Pen Computing Device using Ultra Sound Wave
    ARM7 and SDRAM Memory Controller Porting issue and Cache Hit Ratio Block Design
    8085 CPU design

Hardware Design:
   Various Hardware Platform with Altera and Xilinx FPGA
   Power Line Communication

TOOLS:
   MATLAB, SPW, TI’s Code Composer, Synopsys DC-Compiler, PrimeTime, Cadence Conformal Verify and SOC Encounter P&R, Spyglass, Verdi(Debussy), Altera Quartus II and SOPC/DSP builder, Xilinx ISE10.1/ExtremeDSP/Platform Studio/System Generator, MS DDK, Compuware Driver Studio including SoftICE, Future Plus, Logic Analyzer, Oscilloscope.

Specialties: Software Development, ASIC Design, Hardware/FPGA Design, Digital Signal Processing
